registration: Portable JSON catalogue only; no automatic AWS Glue Data Catalog registration.
physical_nullability_note: Nullability is read from DuckDB metadata. Nullable CTAS/view columns may have stronger semantic checks in the pipeline; no unobserved NOT NULL constraint is invented.

products.name: canonical_order
products.description: Current accepted organization order identity and source attributes, including tombstones.
products.grain: One current canonical order per organization-scoped order business key.
products.key_enforcement: Pipeline quality checks; this field does not assert a physical PRIMARY KEY constraint.

freshness.description: Freshness is the last committed input batch, not a running service SLA or source event time.

quality.meaning: Recorded checks for the committed run; source truth beyond synthetic evidence is not asserted.

lineage.raw: Immutable manifested objects, identified by source and SHA-256 in file_receipts/evidence.

products.example_sql: SELECT business_key,created_at,is_deleted FROM canonical_order ORDER BY created_at;
